modules.content:
Our Story

T&C Integrity & Reliable Trash Services was founded with a simple mission: provide honest, hardworking junk removal and cleaning services that people can actually count on.

We saw too many property managers and homeowners frustrated by no-shows, hidden fees, and sloppy work. We knew there had to be a better way — and that's exactly what we built.

Today, we're proud to be the go-to eviction junk removal and deep cleaning company for property managers, landlords, real estate agents, and homeowners throughout the area. Every job we take on gets the same level of care, professionalism, and thoroughness — because that's what integrity means to us.

modules.title: Integrity
modules.description: We do what we say we'll do. Honest pricing, honest timelines, and honest work — every single time.

modules.title: Reliability
modules.description: When we say we'll be there, we're there. On time. Prepared. Ready to work. You can set your watch to our arrival.

modules.title: Community
modules.description: We donate usable items to local shelters and charities. We recycle responsibly. We take care of our neighbors.

modules.content:
• Fast Turnaround — Most eviction cleanouts completed within 24-48 hours
  • One-Stop Solution — Junk removal AND deep cleaning from one trusted team
  • Volume Discounts — Special pricing for property management companies with multiple units
  • Before/After Documentation — Photo documentation for your records
  • Flexible Scheduling — Early morning, evening, and weekend availability
  • Clear Communication — Real-time updates and no ghosting

• Fully Insured — General liability and workers' comp for your protection
  • Background-Checked Crew — Every team member vetted and trained
  • Eco-Responsible — We prioritize recycling, donation, and responsible disposal
  • No Hidden Fees — The price we quote is the price you pay
  • Satisfaction Guarantee — We're not done until you're satisfied
  • Property-Ready Results — Units left in show-ready condition
